# FC-04 MSE P20 binding amendment v0.4

User direction: 2026-10-29, preparer self-review is acceptable for this P31 package; accurately record the review identity. This does not waive oracle independence, the separate final Gate's reviewer requirements, or the D07 OOM release blocker. Historical v0.1–v0.3 packages and P23 remain unchanged.

## Frozen fixtures and oracles

Per-case setup, expected observations, selectors and evidence paths are frozen in `test-matrix.json`. IDs A/B/C/D/E are deterministic, distinct canonical IDs; Shape is a rectangular Shape, Image is a valid Image, Connector is a valid Connector, Group is a valid Group with child, Section is an accepted valid Section. Use the existing owner/runtime and input routes to create them. A fixture's object IDs and numeric properties are test inputs, never derived from a production projection or implementation's own expected-result code.

Absent property fields use the frozen V1 defaults; checks compare exact object/property state and absence where relevant, not only effective display values. `unchanged` includes canonical bytes/semantics, semantic generation, Scene publication generation/revision, History size/cursor and redo availability, and committed operation count. Where a fixture intentionally changes a revision before admission, capture the comparison snapshot immediately after that intentional change and before executing the stale request.

Each `FC04.MSE-NN` CTest invokes `axiom_fc04_mse_tests --gtest_filter=MultiSelectionMSE.MSE_NN --gtest_fail_if_no_test_selected`; add exactly 27 `add_test` registrations with these names. Use `runtime/composition/CMakeLists.txt` under `BUILD_TESTING` to add `verification/fc04_mse` with an explicit binary dir; the new `verification/fc04_mse/CMakeLists.txt` owns the target and per-case registrations. The root CMake file is unchanged. Native tests run real RuntimeComposition, selection and control owners; do not substitute qualification-hook traces or UI-only fake semantics. Test implementation must prove the specified outcome, including all subcases for compound scenarios. Run `ctest --test-dir <build> -N -R '^FC04[.]MSE-'` and require exactly the 27 frozen names, then run `ctest --test-dir <build> -R '^FC04[.]MSE-' --output-on-failure --no-tests=error` and require 27/27 with no skips. Save CTest listing and JUnit to the case evidence directory; Google Test zero-filter must fail.

Actual Chrome/WASM qualification uses `apps/axiom_canvas_demo/tests/web_fc04_mse.mjs` (new), modeled on the existing CDP Chrome selection runner. It must launch an actual built `axiom_canvas_demo_web` and exercise the real Debug UI/input/Runtime path, not a static HTML mock. It reports distinct IDs `WEB-MSE-03`, `07`, `19`, `20`, `24`, `25`, `26`, `27`, with exact observations from the matching native cases. The UTF-8 JSON result must identify each case, status, Chrome version, URL, build revision, observations and raw failure; missing ID, unknown status, unavailable required capability or empty suite is failure/blocker. Automated composition fixtures are not physical IME/touch acceptance.

Independent expected-value oracle: this matrix, the accepted D06-B policy and frozen Field Registry provide the expected object IDs, field IDs, prior/new values and zero-mutation comparisons. The checker must inspect real canonical/Scene/History results; it must not calculate expectations by calling the same projection, planner, normalizer, command or codec under test. Failure-injection tests retain the existing owner failpoints and never move them after canonical mutation. The existing D07/Selection regressions remain required and their evidence/IDs unchanged. Do not rerun a known hanging OOM sweep as a passing result.

## Source/input identity

Before P32, require a clean tracked and untracked worktree (excluding ignored build outputs), compare every locked source and frozen evidence input to both the source-cursor Git bytes and the actual worktree bytes, verify the package and integrity at the exact materialized commit, and check accepted ancestry/repository. A separate explicit post-start mode may permit the frozen product changes only after an authorized start; never use baseline mode to validate edited sources as unchanged. Frozen evidence inputs remain immutable in both modes. No zero-test, missing Chrome, missing provider or unavailable oracle is a pass.
